component.name: DJ USB Tkit
component.summary: Manage a DJ library and export it to CDJ-ready USB drives

description.p: DJ USB Tkit is a local-first DJ library manager and USB exporter. It scans your music, analyzes tracks, and writes playlists to USB drives that CDJ players read directly.

ul.li: Library scanning, playlist management, and local playback
USB import and export with mirror and additive playlist sync
Local BPM, key, waveform, and artwork analysis
A cue editor for hot cues, beat grid, key, and playback start
USB diagnostics and repair tools, with backups made before repair writes

screenshot.caption: Library view with playlists and a connected USB drive
